deduplication.method: Source URL plus published original hashes and independently recomputed SHA256; class+field-shape+link-port neighborhood topology, five refinement rounds. No old expected targets or engine results used as truth.
deduplication.limit: The25 unavailable original Civitai sources can be compared only to recorded source/hash/node summary, not independently refingerprinted. No absolute topology novelty proof for those25.

oracle_notes: All15 were frozen before the first engine run, including failures; no failure-based sample replacement.
Reference image test initially passed a SHA string but the compile contract expects an explicit $asset object. The harness was corrected and rerun; original failures were not product failures.
Pre-engine output expectation for sample14 marked two real save nodes as manual. Preserving both is an acceptable output policy, so this strict oracle mismatch is not a finding.
Reference auto absence reflects established manual image-role mapping; these remain strict oracle mismatches, not High/Medium defects.

findings.title: Generation size silently targets support masks instead of the connected latent producer

evidence.compile_result: width=1152 changes masks56 and58 only; latent remains authored512x768. No size warning. All links retained.
evidence.code: binding_inference.py infer_bindings dimensions includes model ancestors

findings.impact: Requested image dimensions are ignored while attention mask dimensions are modified. Whole graph preservation alone cannot establish semantic correctness.

findings.title: Dual guider negative inference overwrites a source shared with positive conditioning

evidence.compile_result: negative value replaces6.text, also altering cond1 positive text. No shared-source warning.
evidence.code: binding_inference.py positive_literals only scans positive/conditioning; prompt_owners includes guider with cond1/cond2 but protection misses those roles

findings.impact: Changing the negative field changes positive image-conditioned instructions. Abstain or require an explicit mapping for shared roles.

findings.title: Clear native paired conditioning often requires manual text mapping

evidence.behavior: Paired-output and custom loader boundaries abstain and issue unbound/ambiguous guidance. Explicit manual mappings passed exact whole graph comparison.

findings.impact: Conservative, visible limitation; not counted as semantic auto success. Native contracts could improve convenience without guessing custom output order.

findings.title: Multi-stage scalar policy fans seed out but other scalar knobs use the primary stage

observed: seed -> stageC3 and stageB33; steps/cfg/sampler -> stageC3 only
seed -> sampler8 and upscaler71; steps/cfg/sampler -> sampler8 only
evidence.pre_engine_oracle: Marked multi-stage seed/steps/cfg/sampler as manual, so these remain strict expectation mismatches.

findings.impact: Distinct authored stage seeds become one seed without stage guidance. A documented all-stage seed policy or explicit stage controls would clarify intent; no link/value corruption outside the declared inferred seed targets.

limits: No render, GPU job, model download, browser profile, credential or external paid service.
13 API graphs and2 UI-only graphs; UI-only safely rejected with export guidance and not claimed executable. Largest32 nodes; no120-300 node sample.
Two real API LoRA chains tested with a requested negative override and disable; source weights were positive. No authored active negative weight or authored disabled API LoRA in fixed15.
After the15 were frozen, a source scout identified MagicNodes UI examples with authored disabled negative weight (-1 model,0.2 clip), but they were not added or claimed as engine-tested coverage.
Offline diagnose uses empty object_info to verify exact missing custom-node catalog and malformed links. Installed model availability/custom VALIDATE_INPUTS not verified.
No repeat of global CI gates; Wave3 green CI supplied by coordinator.
